name: How long does window replacement typically take?
description: Window replacement duration varies by project size and complexity, typically taking a few days to a week for a full home.

mainEntity.name: How long does window replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project depends on the number of windows, their size, type, and the complexity of the installation. A typical full-home replacement can take anywhere from a few days to a week. Before the project begins, we conduct a detailed assessment to provide an accurate timeline and ensure we have all necessary materials, which helps avoid delays.
